counting how often 10bit lands in the drawer
vibe: A research-first builder who pairs cognitive science papers with scrappy local-model prototypes and writes honestly about where they fail.
lines: Conscious thought runs at about 10 bits a second. 10bit is my little furry guard for those bits.
I ran 10bit 72 times. The rules agent passed half the tasks. Qwen passed none and got put in a drawer every single day.
First two hours, Qwen looked great. Then it nagged its way into the drawer. One demo would have hidden all of that.
Egemen and I hooked an agent up to a Hue lamp. The bridge said red, amber, green worked. The lamp had no power.
Through smolagents, Qwen gave empty replies on up to 7 of 10 steps. A short loop straight against Ollama had none.
Mia gives you cues, not answers. You have to do the remembering yourself.
Final project is LemmeSpiralForYou with Egemen. Repetitive thought helps when it gets concrete, and hurts when it stays abstract.
